cached_path: download a URL or resolve a local file path and return the cached file path
load_archive_file: load and extract a tar archive file from a URL or local path into a directory
get_from_cache: download a file from a URL or S3 path to a local cache directory and return the path
read_set_from_file: read a text file line by line and return a deduplicated set of strings
url_to_filename: generate a deterministic SHA256 hashed filename from a URL and optional ETag
